subject: Scheduling: Pre-sales architecture workshop (post-discovery)
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Chen <sarah.chen@novaretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-21T16:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps — architecture workshop after discovery

Hi Sarah,

Thanks again for the discovery call earlier — great discussion and clear signal that you want a short technical session focused on integrating Redwood for low-latency personalization and secure data flows. My ask: can we lock in a 60-minute architecture workshop next week so our solutions engineer (Marissa) and I can walk through an integration pattern and expected latency/cost tradeoffs?

I attached a one-page agenda and a quick SOC2 evidence checklist so your security folks know what we typically surface. Proposed slots (all PT):
- Tue 2026-05-26 09:00–10:00
- Wed 2026-05-27 11:00–12:00
- Thu 2026-05-28 14:00–15:00

If none of those work, tell me two windows that do and we’ll adapt. High-level goals for the session:
- Review Nova Retail’s inference topology and traffic profile
- Discuss model serving options (hosted vs dedicated vs private)
- Quantization and KV cache implications for personalization workloads
- Next steps & mutual action plan

Thanks,
Sean
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0124

Attachments: 20260521-redwood-technical-agenda.pdf (application/pdf), SOC2-evidence-request.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

Thanks Sean — appreciate the agenda.

Quick note: our infra lead Andy will be out Tue/Thu mornings and is only available Wed afternoons PT next week. Also we have a weekly executive sync on Wed 11–11:30 that might bleed into a hard stop. Can you do Wed 2026-05-27 at 13:30–14:30 PT instead? That would let Andy join at 13:45 when he gets back from a call. If Marissa can start with the integration sketch and we keep the first 30 minutes technical, that would be ideal.

—Sarah
Sarah Chen

Thanks — I’m available at 13:30 PT on Wed the 27th and can lead the integration section. A couple quick asks so I can prep:
- Could you share traffic characteristics (RPS, 95th token lengths, peak qps) for the personalization endpoints?
- Any current constraints on third-party model hosting or requirements for VPC/on-prem?

I’ll prepare two pattern diagrams (hosted + dedicated) and a short slide on latency vs cost with caching/quantization options. I’ll also bring sample numbers for a 100 TPS steady-state scenario.
